prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1400; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a side-impact motor vehicle collision occurring at a controlled intersection. Complaints at intake included cervical and lumbar pain, stiffness, and intermittent headaches originating at the base of the skull. Neurological screening was unremarkable, with full strength and intact sensation in all extremities and no signs of radiculopathy. Cervical and lumbar range of motion was restricted by approximately 30 to 40 percent in flexion and rotation, with paraspinal muscle tenderness noted on palpation.

Over the course of seven visits, treatment consisted of manual therapy, guided therapeutic exercise for core and cervical stabilization, and instruction in home postural care. Pain levels were tracked at each visit and showed steady improvement, with the patient reporting a reduction from moderate to mild discomfort by the final encounter. Range of motion improved substantially, and the patient tolerated all sessions well without adverse reaction.

Diagnosis at discharge: cervical strain and lumbar strain, both improving. The patient was advised to continue the home exercise program, avoid heavy lifting until fully recovered, and return if symptoms worsen or new neurological symptoms develop. Prognosis for full recovery is good.
